limitations: Gate L chains and J/SP-6.3 arms run on one seed (3) in ECON creation worlds, not the integrated civilization (CIV finishes them).
Compute metering is still the in-sandbox line counter (cost_model deterministic); J.7 uses hand-work minutes, a pre-existing resource independent of metering, and reports incumbent compute as well.
Parent-side adoption by ablation can still be gamed by a program that detects the ablation stub and changes its output; tracer overwrite and shadow copies are defeated.
Source-of-funds tracing replays the ledger (linear in ledger size, cached per world seq); no incremental tracer yet (audit F 3.3 / S8).
Platform review and exchange-statistics filters look one hop back over 90 days (deliberately weaker than the evaluator).
Unlabelled admitted personas are never independent customers for objectives (fail closed); harnesses must label controllers.

Work activities: value of time is drawn from the individual's spendable money (the population exports no income feature); word of mouth reads contacts' own experience records directly (a modelled conversation).

work.value decision model and rivals adaptive rules are uncalibrated documented assumptions (fidelity rows needed); ad response uses commercial_response@1 response types re-based to a 3% search click rate.
Media and educational demand from the population is not implemented (SP-6.1 media scenario uses scripted buyers; education is measured on the learner's own program).
Subjective usefulness from diverse grounded participant responses (6.3) is not implemented.
Legacy 5.0 innovation scenario worlds (innovation/scenarios.py, adopt.py, needs with visible:true) remain for historical unit tests only.
Labour market task quality is still a formula of skill match (labor.py unchanged).
